verdict.rationale: dLocal documents card acceptance through Smart Fields and a ready-made Checkout Redirect, plus no-integration Payment Links pitched as letting you "go to market in no time." Sandbox credentials are available right after login, and sandbox and production run from the same account. However, the evidence only shows test payments; nothing shows a new merchant being approved and taking a live card payment within a day. Missing for 10: documented self-serve signup and production activation timeline, KYC/onboarding duration, independent or hands-on confirmation of a same-day live card payment.
